name: page-summarizer
description: Extension for summarizing websites with local or cloud LLMs

scripts.build: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chrome
scripts.build:firefox: vite build --config vite.config.ts && node scripts/build-manifest.js firefox
scripts.build:chrome: vite build --config vite.config.ts && node scripts/build-manifest.js chrome
scripts.firefox:build: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build -s dist-firefox
